goals.title: Selected Game Resolver: Map proposed legs & cited rows to selected event_ids
goals.description: Implement/update deterministic Selected Game Resolver to extract unique event_ids from proposed picks/legs (event_id, game_id, row, match, side, selection) and scorecard citations mapped against parsed slate headers, dropping unselected slate games.
goals.verificationCriteria: Unit test confirms selected event_ids are extracted from picks/scorecards and unselected slate games excluded.

goals.title: Stage 2 Risk Critic Seat Scoping & Tool Suite + CRITIC SCOPE prompt
goals.description: In analystExecution.ts / seatToolLoop.ts / constants.ts, restrict Stage 2 Risk Critic allGameIds strictly to proposedAuditContext.targetGameIds, filter board headers to selected games, grant get_market_movement, get_injury_and_roster_delta, get_matchup_fundamentals, get_environment_and_weather, and add CRITIC SCOPE prompt rule.
goals.verificationCriteria: Stage 2 Critic receives only selected game headers/IDs, pulls tools for selected games only, and preserves pass-field & injury attribution rules.

goals.title: Deep Analysis Verification Critic Loop Scoped Tool Pulls
goals.description: In lifecycle.ts / verificationPipeline.ts / engine/index.ts, extract proposed leg event_ids before Critic verification, pull get_market_movement, get_injury_and_roster_delta, get_matchup_fundamentals for those selected games via tool registry/cache, build [Tool Evidence] and [Raw Board Sample] exclusively from selected games, and include verified games in coveredEventIds.
goals.verificationCriteria: Multi-sport parlay (e.g. Lakers -7.5, Clippers -6.5, Dallas ML) pulls evidence for all selected games and passes verification without false truncation vetoes.

goals.title: Tests & Full Verification (tsc, vitest, smoke-start)
goals.description: Add comprehensive tests for dual-stage Critic scoping and multi-sport parlays; run npx tsc --noEmit, npx vitest run, and node scripts/smoke-start.mjs.
goals.verificationCriteria: tsc --noEmit, full vitest run, and smoke-start pass.
